annotations.title: Audit App Store & Google Play Churn, ASO & Developer Leads

description:
Analyze iOS App Store and Google Play apps for silent churn divergence, 14-language review pain clusters, ASO gaps, ad/MMP stacks, and verified EU-DSA developer contacts.

Parameters: Supply searchTerms, iosAppIds, androidPackageIds, upstreamItems, or topChartFeed (omitting all defaults to a 3-app demo query). mode selects app_intelligence or review_stream; pre-charge filters (minOpportunityScore, painBucketFilter, switchIntentOnly, onlyWithEmail) gate billing, and watchDiff + dedupStoreName track incremental changes. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Writes optional watchDiff KV snapshots and webhookUrl alerts, isolates per-app WAF or store errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY without crashing, and bills $5/1K unified apps or $0.50/1K streamed reviews ($0 on filtered or unchanged skips).

Use for mobile app churn intelligence, ASO audits, and mobile agency outbound; do not use for Shopify web store tracking (use monitor_shopify_competitor_deltas) or local SMB audits (use audit_local_b2b_websites).

androidPackageIds.description: Google Play package IDs (e.g. ["com.duolingo"]) or play.google.com URLs; auto-matched to iOS including cross-script pairs.

autoLocalLanguage.description: Auto-map each country storefront to its native local review language across 35+ countries.

crmPreset.description: Optional flat OWASP CSV-safe CRM export preset.

dedupStoreName.description: Named Key-Value Store used when watchDiff is enabled.

includeDeveloperEmailEnrich.description: Combine EU-DSA trader contacts with 1-hop website contact discovery and MX verification.

includeWebsiteGtmXray.description: Run pure-HTTP gtm.js, 12-subdomain CNAME MMP, DNS TXT, .well-known & app-ads.txt X-Ray.

iosAppIds.description: Numeric Apple track IDs (e.g. ["570060128"]) or apps.apple.com URLs; auto-matched to Google Play via AASA/assetlinks.

maxApps.description: Maximum unified apps to analyze or scan (1-200).

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Maximum combined iOS+Android reviews per app in review_stream mode (1-10,000).

minOpportunityScore.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps with opportunityScore >= threshold ($0 below).

mode.description: app_intelligence outputs unified iOS+Android app audits ($5/1K); review_stream streams individual reviews up to 10,000/app ($0.50/1K).

onlyWithEmail.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps with a verified developer email ($0 otherwise).

outreachPersona.description: Tailors deterministic $0-LLM outreach copy to your agency or sales motion.

painBucketFilter.description: Optional pre-charge filter restricting emitted apps or reviews to specific pain themes ($0 when skipped).

sampleReviewsPerStore.description: Reviews sampled per store in app_intelligence mode at $0 extra review charge (0-500).

searchTerms.description: Keywords searched simultaneously across iOS App Store and Google Play (e.g. ["invoice maker", "habit tracker"]).

starFilter.description: Optional review rating filter while preserving unbiased recent churn baselines.

switchIntentOnly.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps/reviews showing competitor switch intent ($0 otherwise).

topChartCategory.description: Commercial category applied when topChartFeed is enabled.

topChartFeed.description: Optional live App Store or Google Play Top Chart seed feed.

upstreamItems.description: Optional structured pipeline items ({ iosAppId, androidPackageId, appUrl, domain, companyName, label }) for zero-permission n8n/Clay/MCP chaining.

watchDiff.description: Persist per-app snapshots (10,000-ID ring buffer + 90-run history) to skip unchanged runs at $0.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL (Slack Block Kit / Discord Embed / Make / n8n).

name: audit_app_store_churn_leads

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Unified iOS + Google Play app churn intelligence records or streamed reviews.

inAppSdkStack.description: Observable ad, MMP, and privacy SDK stack.

overallBlendedRating.description: Lifetime blended rating across available stores.

paidAdSpendVerified.description: Whether active paid-UA tags or MMPs were verified.

silentChurnDivergence.description: Recent minus lifetime rating divergence (negative indicates silent churn).
